test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-3) Official Paper (Held On: 17 June 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Some students are sitting in a row facing North. Their location is subject to the following conditions:

1. B sits immediate next to both G and D.

2. H sits third to the left of B. H sits second to the right of A.

3. C sits immediate next to both H and G.

4. A and F are sitting at the extreme ends of the row, and F sits second to the right of B.

How many students are there in the row ?

2) B sits immediate next to both G and D.
